content.short: Stablecoin banking app for everyday money.
content.description: Plasma One is a stablecoin-native neobank from Plasma, a Layer 1 blockchain purpose-built for stablecoin payments and backed by investors including Peter Thiel and Bitfinex. The app brings saving, spending, and earning in digital dollars into one place: users can hold USDT, earn 10%+ yields, spend directly from their stablecoin balance with physical or virtual cards that offer up to 4% cashback, and send USDT instantly with zero fees. Accepted at over 150 million merchants across 150+ countries, Plasma One targets users in emerging markets where access to reliable dollars is in high demand. Built on the Plasma network, it aims to make stablecoins function as a complete everyday bank account rather than just a crypto holding, from onboarding to spending.
content.meta: Plasma One is a stablecoin-native neobank for saving, spending, and earning in dollars. Discover Plasma One and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
